Method of Attack: Encrypts and obfuscates applications to bypass security programs
Executes a PowerShell script to download additional payloads
Uses reflective injection techniques to load the final payload in memory
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with vulnerable Oracle Weblogic Server installations
Attack Vector: Exploits an Oracle Weblogic Server vulnerability
Downloads a PowerShell script via HTTP URI 'wls-wsat/CoordinatorPortType'
Executes the PowerShell script to download and run ScrubCrypt
Uses a batch file to masquerade as a system update
